notes: Section 13, 1935 edition (Ingleside Terraces, Merced Heights / Ocean View north, St. Francis Wood, Balboa Park, Westwood Park, Mt. Davidson; joins Sec. 14 above, 6 right, 12 below as scanned), 5400x4144; the frame stands ~230 px in from the left page edge and ~320 px from the right. 1-bit photocopy, the sheet lies on its side (title reads top to bottom). Frame on all four sides: thick bar (~15 px), 2-5 px of white, thin inner rule (3-5 px, the innermost rule), with a thick + thin quarter arc in every corner; each thin arc joins its two side rules through a short connector (a 5-10 px joggle). Rule 1: the outline lies on the first or second px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, points every <=150 px along the sides and <=30 px along the arcs, so the bowed rules are followed. Rule 2: the outline follows the thin arc's inner edge 1-2 px inside it and steps round each connector on its map side, so arcs, connectors and everything beyond them are outside. Page turned ~0.4 deg and bowed: thin rule's inner face top y 413 (x 462) -> 396 (x 4825), bottom 3995 -> 3986 (mid) -> 3988, left x 235 (y 629) -> 260 (y 3766), right 5052 -> 5076. Arcs are not exact circles (the tails run straight into the connectors): radii TL ~208, TR ~226, BR ~210, BL ~210. Connector steps at TL y 629 / x 462, TR x 4825 / y 621, BR y 3767 / x 4855, BL x 496 / y 3766. Kind (b), map ink that truly touches the frame and is left under the outline (the first-residential hatching runs to the frame on three sides, so 303 of 328 stretches hold some ink): hatch lines run into the bottom rule nearly all along and into the BL and BR arcs (one into the BR-right connector at y ~3763-3768, one into the BR-bottom connector at x ~4847-4857, one into the BL-bottom junction at x ~474-488); a solid block is fused to the right rule at y ~2660-3040 (its lower end is mottled in the copy, y ~3040-3060) and block lines run along and into the right rule elsewhere; solid commercial strips are fused to the bottom rule at x ~1270-1420, 2270-2420 and 3370-3520; street and block lines lie along the top rule (1 px inside it or fused) at x ~1440-1810, 2250-2400 and 4030-4080 and meet it elsewhere. The left side is clean: blank paper lies between the left rule and the map. 'Join Sec.' lettering prints outside the frame. remove[0]: the rotated CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP / PREPARED BY / CITY PLANNING COMMISSION / 1935 / R.S. WOODWARD title, LEGEND with its six swatches, labels and ditto marks, and the scale bar with 1000 and its SCALE lettering (top right, no ruled box; ink x 4367-5022, y 458-1140). It stands in a pocket of blank paper cut out of the hatching, with map ink close on the left and lower left, so the outline (24 points, 3-5 px outside the ink) threads the gaps: top edge y 454 between a hatched block corner (bottom y 449) and the swatches (top y 458), stepped down right of the swatches; top-right corner cut off inside the TR arc (the thin arc passes 4-6 px from the C of CITY); bottom stepped round COMMISSION and LIGHT INDUSTRIAL DIST.; at the lower left it passes between the ditto marks and the block number 2386 / the West Portal street lines (x 4444.5, y 1125.5); the left edge runs along the scale bar with a bulge for SCALE, 3 px from the hatch-line ends at x <= 4359. No ink under it. remove[1]: the compass rose (larger here: N tip ~4166,2171; S ~4171,2441; E ~4289,2304; W ~4060,2304; NE ~4251,2221; SE ~4252,2387; SW ~4086,2388; NW ~4085,2227) with its long arrow (tail feather x 3751-3802, y 2298-2320; head with crescent, ring and point, tip ~4578,2302) and the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~4551,2414). THE COMPASS IS PRINTED OVER MAP INK: the rose stands in the diagonally hatched area (hatching at ~30 deg; the hatch lines break off close to the rose but short pieces lie between its points and lines cross its spokes), the tail shaft runs ~260 px west of the rose's W tip across the hatching, both lines of Cresta Vista Drive and its lettering, and between two block lines (it passes 4 px under one, y 2301-2303 against the shaft's 2307-2309), and the feather lies in a block against a street line and a hatch line; the arrow and the needle run east across the hatching and a curved street line, and the arrow head ends 5 px short of Juanita Way. So the outline is kept tight (42 points, more than the usual 12): a hull 4-6 px outside the points of the rose and strips 2-4 px outside the ink of the tail, the arrow and the needle; map ink inside the hull and the strips is removed with the compass and the outline crosses hatch and street lines (remove-outline ink ~400). One hatch line runs from just above the N tip (2 px of paper between them) to just above the NE tip, exactly along the hull's edge: the edge is drawn 4-5 px outside that line, on paper, so ~100 px of it fall inside. remove[2]: the SECTION 13 badge (ring centre 4893.2,3902.8, outer radius 57.3), an octagon 5.5 px outside the ring. THE BADGE IS PRINTED OVER MAP INK TOO: hatch lines and a block line with tick marks run through the ring, so the octagon crosses them (ink ~57); its lower right corner comes within ~3 px of the BR arc's outline. Not removed: street names, block numbers, BALBOA PARK. Doubt: the tail's upper edge has only 2 px of paper either side between the block line and the shaft.
drawn_by: Claude (training-label agent LD, issue #71), 2026-11-21: from the scan and inputs/frame-labels/README.md only (no model output, no test label looked at). Sides: the thin rule's outer face (beside the white gap to the bar) measured on every px and fitted locally (+-60 px), its inner face taken as that plus the local rule width (a low percentile of the run widths, since fused map ink only widens a run); the outline placed 1-2.5 px inside the inner face by a per-px path search that prefers 2 px and moves only to get off ink. Corner arcs: rays through a fitted centre for the circular part, the tails followed px by px to the connectors; connector steps read from pixel dumps. Remove polygons from full-resolution crops (hatch lines greyed out to see the rose) and measured ink boxes. Checked: every vertex close up, all eight connectors at 6x, the four arcs at 3x, px-by-px statistics of the outline against the rule, margins of each remove polygon against the ink pieces, and the ranked ink stretches.
